jobs.name: A · 紫蝶清幽
jobs.summary: 上翼肩领 · 下翼垂摆 · 清冷神秘
jobs.detail: SILVER hair in a smooth compact shoulder-length mass, blunt split fringe; tiny Chinese jade crown built as two small curved antenna-like pins, NOT tall horns. A distinct softly angular short oval face, low gently arched brows, half-lidded quiet purple eyes and a subtle reserved smile. Violet/ink-purple/pale lilac/old gold. Costume silhouette mimics a BUTTERFLY AT REST WITH WINGS FOLDED: two broad upper forewing curves become a SHORT rounded Chinese shoulder collar, taper into fitted cross-collar bodice over fuller bust, narrow waist, then two rounded pointed lower-wing robe panels hanging quietly along sides over slim charcoal trousers and purple boots. Sleeves moderately wide but hang CLOSE to body, absolutely no outspread fan arms or gigantic cape. On each main wing-like panel just one pale lilac wedge tracing a wing vein, no repeated cloud curls. One small purple-jade fly whisk held low beside hip, white tail a single compact hanging teardrop, other hand lightly rests at waist holding TWO small talisman papers folded together downward. Two short lilac waist ties. Calm elegant vertical weight, both feet distinct.
jobs.prompt: Create ONE original ADULT female CHINESE TAOIST game character, mid twenties. User corrected the direction: extract BUTTERFLY as the overall design element and REDESIGN, not copy a lavish sorceress reference or just put butterfly prints onto a generic robe. Turn butterfly FOREWING/HINDWING shapes into real garment tailoring, a few wing-vein divisions into broad cloth panels, antenna curves into small Chinese hairpins. No literal wings growing from body, horns, elf ears, Western crown, huge spell pose, billowing hair or long floating ribbons. Input image1 is only the approved compact GEM-ICON game STYLE/PROPORTION reference, NOT its face/hair/red costume; image2 is gem material/block-painting style. Figure should look from same compact game roster: about FOUR skull-crown-to-sole head heights excluding accessories, generous head size, short elegant torso/legs, clearly mature adult face and full soft feminine bust/waist/hip curves through well-tailored opaque cloth; not six-head fashion proportions, not child or heavy bulky body. Chinese diagonal cross-collar and simple Taoist implement/small yin-yang clasp identify profession. QUIET STANDING ONLY: natural subtle hip weight shift with soft knees, both feet planted visibly apart, arms resting down or bent close to waist, props low, no arms spread, no casting gesture or lunge, no lifted foot. Only TWO SHORT ribbon tails at waist or hair with a tiny gentle curve, no long airborne hair or flying skirts. Graphic personality: distinct face silhouette, simple brows/eyes/nose/mouth, no glam eyeliner, realistic iris or generic pretty face clones. Drawing same bold clean contour, a few big coherent 2-3 shadow masses, broad quiet colored planes, simplified gem-icon handpainting, no fine mosaic/filigree/scale pattern. A butterfly shape should be apparent from the outfit's silhouette and sewn panel shapes even without surface motifs; only 2-3 broad wing-vein divisions total, NOT butterfly logos everywhere. jobs.name: B · 墨蝶利落
jobs.summary: 折翼斜襟 · 短装收袖 · 干练坚定
jobs.detail: INK BLACK asymmetrical ear-length bob with blunt diagonal edge and exposed near ear; one small DARK JADE antenna-curve hair clasp following temple, no ponytail/bun. Short square-diamond face, straight blunt brows, clear focused eyes, short nose and confident tiny uneven smile, no scar/eyeliner. Ink-black/dark plum/cinnabar small accent/ivory. BUTTERFLY ANGULAR FOLDED WING DESIGN: short tailored cross-wrap jacket whose single diagonal ivory facing forms one crisp upper-wing edge over full bust, short shoulder cap one side and fitted elbow sleeve opposite; narrow dark waist and TWO very short broad angular hindwing hip tabs over dark cropped riding trousers and practical flat charcoal boots. Just two broad plum panels divided by one cream seam as wing veins, clean geometry, no decorations everywhere. Quiet stable standing with a mild hip tilt, one hand naturally down holding a plain short PEACH-WOOD RITUAL SWORD pointing safely down outside leg, other hand relaxed over sash. Small single paper seal attached to guard, no draw/attack/casting pose. One pair very short muted-red ties by waist. Entire silhouette crisp compact asymmetric, distinct from soft purple robe.

jobs.name: C · 粉蝶灵巧
jobs.summary: 圆翼短袖 · 花瓣叠摆 · 俏皮亲和
jobs.detail: CHESTNUT soft short wavy bob with a short broken rounded fringe and ONE small off-center folded low coil behind head, a tiny apricot two-arc butterfly-antenna pin, no double buns or large bow. Short rounded face with blunt chin, one curved eyebrow slightly lifted, bright simple round-almond eyes, small open friendly smile with one simple tooth shape; mature adult and full natural feminine curves. Pale peach/cream/sage green, very little bronze. BUTTERFLY ROUNDED FOREWING tailoring: small gently puffed short sleeves like two quiet rounded wing lobes, shaped opaque peach crossover bodice with cream neckline, fitted sage waist, two overlapping short round hindwing hem panels over soft sage calf-length pants and cream/peach flat shoes. TWO big peach/cream adjacent shapes provide wing color fields; only one subtle curved vein seam, no cloud motifs, no printed butterflies. Quiet lightly tilted standing, both feet grounded, one hand holds ONE SMALL BRONZE RITUAL BELL at waist by short handle/ring, other rests on a small simple Taoist talisman pouch. Tiny paper seal on bell, no medicine gourd or basket. Two short soft green ties slightly curving. Light friendly round silhouette, arms close to body.

jobs.name: D · 青蝶沉静
jobs.summary: 窄翼直襟 · 长短叠片 · 沉稳内敛
jobs.detail: DEEP BLUE BLACK smooth straight hair to collarbone, crisp horizontal fringe, tucked sides and one long simple pale-jade horizontal hairpin ending in a tiny oval loop, no horn crown/braid/ponytail. A subtly long rounded face with blunt chin, low level brows, very calm narrow half-open graphic eyes and almost neutral thoughtful mouth. Moon ivory/slate blue/deep jade with one small muted bronze accent. BUTTERFLY SLENDER FOLDED WINGS: a tailored high diagonal Chinese collar jacket fitted over fuller bust and a modest narrow sash, two close hanging long narrow outer robe panels with smooth gently pointed butterfly wing ends at lower calf, one shorter contrasting inner wing panel to knee. Long narrow sleeves, no huge fan sleeves. Broad slate-blue wing-edge band and only TWO large pale triangular vein divisions, no ornamental moons/stars/cloud curls or elaborate repeated trigrams. Charcoal slim pants and simple slate boots visible under open panels. Quiet upright slight contrapposto, arms bent LOW at waist holding a SMALL bronze Taoist compass disc with both hands naturally supported, center simple yin-yang and eight broad sectors but no tiny writing. Two short pale-blue waist ties only. Restrained narrow vertical silhouette clearly different from other three.
